Direct regulation of the transcription factor ChREBP activity by glucose and its metabolites
The amino-terminal domain of the ChREBP protein has several overlapping structural motifs. Of these, the GRACE and LID motifs
stand out. While GRACE has a transcription-promoting effect in the absence of glucose or any of its metabolites, LID interacts with
